lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: I was making a cake when you called.

translation.vi: Mình đang làm bánh thì bạn gọi đến.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Great! Is it for my birthday party?

translation.vi: Tuyệt! Có phải cho bữa tiệc sinh nhật của mình không?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Yes! I have a big cake.

translation.vi: Ừ! Mình có một cái bánh to.

gloss.en: a fun event with friends and food
a sweet food made with flour, eggs and sugar

grammar_notes: Use the past continuous to talk about an action that was happening when another action happened. For example: 'I was making a cake when you called.'
interaction_prompts: What were you doing when a friend called you last time?
